purpose.summary: Batch report program that produces a CSV file ('stsottoc_<user>.csv') analysing sales movement margins per product and customer. It reads warehouse movement headers and lines, looks up articles, customers, price lists, taxes, and other reference tables, then calls an Excel-output routine.
